details:
Been having this issue for weeks now and I'm at my wits end. Tested on both Unity 6 beta and default public version client. Environment is CachyOS running VRC through GE-Proton10-33-rtsp24-1 and with following launch options

PRESSURE_VESSEL_IMPORT_OPENXR_1_RUNTIMES=1 WINEDLLOVERRIDES="iyuv_32=" game-performance %command% --watch-worlds --enable-sdk-log-levels

Social tab and friends list will stop updating at some point and never recover. Sometimes opening a friend or instance's page will cause at least a partial refresh, causing something like finding out someone has actually been offline for 2 hours and their status goes to black as it should. But in the social tab they're still shown as being in an instance while on black.

I've had it happen where after checking all of my friends i had instances in my social tab that were shown mostly full of people who were actually offline, or instances showing stuff like 0/8 users. In fact, the instance might not even exist anymore since an hour, but it will still be there in the social tab.

People coming online also is not shown. If i click the profile of someone shown as offline it might turn out they've been online for the past hour, and it might even show me the instance they're in, BUT neither the instance nor the user will be shown in the social tab.

I know there's other threads about this, opening a new one anyway because they're old and it's been literal years since someone posted in the main ones, yet the problem still exists. I've tried the common fixes mentioned like disabling ipv6 and setting Cloudflare DNS, neither helped.

Here are the logs from two sessions, in both of them the problem occurred. Put them on Github because they're too big for Pastebin

https://gist.github.com/nikidash/bdd6e523f1b3935ad6e7c47bedf017fc
title: Social tab and friend list not updating
